plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Political Science (BA/BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Political Science Degree Maps (2026-2027)', Political Science (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the B.S.: the catalog prints a single combined line, Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly; the map expressly does not include the B.A.'s 16-credit foreign-language requirement (the B.S. requirement is 12 credits of math or science). Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (15 in all eight semesters) and the plan to 120. Cross-check: the catalog's Political Science Curriculum totals 40 credits (Core Requirements 16, Political Science Electives 24), and every named core course appears in the map: the Core's 'Complete One of the Following' choice (POLS 2100 Introduction to International Relations or POLS 2200 Introduction to Comparative Politics) is placed by the map as POLS 2100 in Year 2 Fall, recorded as printed with the catalog alternative disclosed, and the 24 elective credits are the map's eight generic 'Major Upper-division Elective' slots, recorded as choice slots with the catalog's elective course list. The map prints POLS 1100's title truncated ('American National Gov't'); the catalog title is recorded. The map's Year 1 Spring quantitative literacy row is printed as 'MATH' with no course number and is recorded as a GE choice slot. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
